1.title: How Trump Put Himself in the Middle of America’s 250th
1.summary: The president placed his image and initiatives front and center, blurring the line, critics said, between loyalty to nation and loyalty to him.

2.title: First American Woman Rows Solo From California to Hawaii
2.summary: Kelsey Pfendler, a Grand Canyon river-rafting guide, completed the journey of more than 2,300 miles in a rowboat named Lily in just under 44 days, according to data from the Ocean Rowing Society International.

3.title: Mallory McMorrow Suspends Senate Bid in Democrats’ Heated Michigan Primary
3.summary: The state senator sought to carve a middle path between a left-wing candidate and one backed by the party establishment, but she gained little traction.

4.title: Australia space agency has found 'likely source' of mystery space balls
4.summary: The agency says that they "appear to be pressure vessels from a space launch vehicle".

5.title: China Frees Pastor Detained in Crackdown on Religion After Trump’s Urging
5.summary: Ezra Jin Mingri was released nearly two months after President Trump raised his case with China’s leader, Xi Jinping, during a visit to Beijing.

6.title: Australian PM apologises for 'inappropriate' comments about Kylie Minogue
6.summary: Albanese has apologised 'unequivocally' after his remarks prompted a backlash.
